title: The Best Day of My Life
description: Practise past tenses, so and such, and -ed adjectives, then write a story about a special day.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: It was ___ a beautiful morning that I decided to go to the beach.
exercises.explanation: Use "such (a/an) + adjective + noun" and "so + adjective": such a beautiful morning, so beautiful.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: We ___ (catch) the early train to the mountains.
exercises.explanation: "Catch" is irregular. Its past simple form is "caught".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: The sun was shining when I woke up.
When I woke up the sun was shining.
exercises.explanation: Use the past continuous (was shining) for the background and the past simple (woke up) for the event.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I was so surprising when I saw all my friends there.
answers: I was so surprised when I saw all my friends there.
exercises.explanation: Use the -ed adjective to describe how a person feels: I was surprised.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.explanation: After a superlative, use the present perfect with "ever": the best day I have ever had.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: While we ___ (eat) lunch, my dad told us the big news.
exercises.explanation: After "while", use the past continuous for the longer action: while we were eating.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I was very tired. ___, I didn't want the day to end.
exercises.explanation: "However" shows a contrast: being tired would normally make you want the day to end.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word SUCH. Begin: "It was ..."
exercises.text: The day was so exciting that I couldn't sleep.
answers: It was such an exciting day that I couldn't sleep.
It was such an exciting day that I could not sleep.
exercises.explanation: "So + adjective" becomes "such + a/an + adjective + noun": so exciting - such an exciting day.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: We spent the whole afternoon ___ in the sea.
exercises.explanation: "Spend time" is followed by the -ing form: spent the afternoon swimming.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.explanation: After "full of" we need a noun. The noun from "excite" is "excitement".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: "Get up" means to get out of bed. Its past form is "got up".

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The cake was more big than I expected.
answers: The cake was bigger than I expected.
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives take -er in the comparative. With one vowel + one consonant, double the consonant: big - bigger.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: We went to a restaurant ___ my parents had their first date.
exercises.explanation: Use "where" after a place noun when a full clause follows: a restaurant where my parents had ...

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word WHILE. Begin: "We found a message in a bottle ..."
exercises.text: We were walking along the beach. We found a message in a bottle.
answers: We found a message in a bottle while we were walking along the beach.
exercises.explanation: Use "while" + past continuous for the longer action, and the past simple for the shorter action.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: If I ___ (can) live that day again, I would do everything the same.
exercises.explanation: In the second conditional, use the past form after "if". The past of "can" is "could".

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: After open my presents, we went out for breakfast.
answers: After opening my presents, we went out for breakfast.
After I opened my presents, we went out for breakfast.
After I had opened my presents, we went out for breakfast.
exercises.explanation: After a preposition such as "after", use the -ing form (or a full clause): after opening.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: It was the best present I've ever had.
exercises.explanation: Use the superlative + present perfect with "ever": the best present I've ever had.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We must leave early because the train was at seven.
answers: We had to leave early because the train was at seven.
exercises.explanation: "Must" has no past form. For an obligation in the past, use "had to".

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word WAS. Begin: "The whole day ..."
exercises.text: My parents organised the whole day.
answers: The whole day was organised by my parents.
exercises.explanation: The past simple passive is was/were + past participle. Use "by" to say who did the action.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word DECIDED. Begin: "We ..."
exercises.text: We made a decision to stay until sunset.
answers: We decided to stay until sunset.
exercises.explanation: "Decide" is followed by the to-infinitive: decided to stay.

task.prompt: Write a story with the title "The Best Day of My Life".
contentPoints: Say when the day was and where you were.
Describe how you and other people felt.
Explain why the day was so special.
task.modelAnswer:
The best day of my life was my fifteenth birthday. When I woke up that morning, the sun was shining, but my house was strangely quiet. My parents had already gone to work, and nobody had said "Happy birthday".

I felt a bit sad as I walked to school. However, when I opened the door of my classroom, I got the biggest surprise of my life. All my friends were there, and they were holding a huge banner with my name on it. Even my teacher was smiling.

After school, my parents took us all to the beach. While we were eating pizza on the sand, my dad gave me a present: a ticket to see my favourite band.

It was such a perfect day that I couldn't sleep that night. I'll never forget it.
